description.en: Same as AddPartyNum_Message, but plays the "J_07" jingle instead of "J_08" — used for adding several important members at once.
Array of param IDs, one per member.
Array of position-lock flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-enable flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-lock flags, one per member.
Array of levels to set, one per member (-1 to leave unchanged).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Add several important party members in sequence with the "J_07" jingle presentation
AddPartyNum_Important_Message(3, charaID, ptLock, avaEnable, avaLock, level);
